boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 139 is a Super Hard dual-tier board — a rainbow upper grid drains into a lower tier through paired down-arrows, feeding `17` and `13` purple tubes flanked by blue `4` side counters. The upper grid empties first, then the real puzzle begins: the lower tier's tubes gate each drop phase independently, and a green `1` tile at the bottom-left must wait until the border counters align.
landmarks: Block Out Level 139 is a Super Hard dual-tier board — a rainbow upper grid drains into a lower tier through paired down-arrows, feeding `17` and `13` purple tubes flanked by blue `4` side counters.

The upper grid empties first, then the real puzzle begins: the lower tier's tubes gate each drop phase independently, and a green `1` tile at the bottom-left must wait until the border counters align.
The board mixes Purple, Red, Green and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Keep both blue 4 squares sealed until the upper grid is fully empty — spending either early locks the 17 tube.
Clear the blue 1 bar at the top of the lower tier before touching the right-column red scraps.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Feed the top rainbow row down the red left down-arrow without splitting the yellow right pair on the upper grid.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Clear the remaining upper-grid rows through the yellow right down-arrow until the top tier is fully empty.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Spend both blue 4 side counters once the upper grid clears, unlocking the lower 17 tube.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Break the lower blue 1 bar at the top of the bottom tier after the 17 counter hits zero.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Clear the left-border 5/1/1 counters and the right-border 1/1 pair through the side lanes.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Detonate the green 2×2 cluster at the bottom-center and feed the last red/pink right-column scraps for the SUPER HARD board clear.

failurePoints: Spending either blue 4 counter before the upper grid empties, locking the 17 tube above 9.
Clearing the right-column red scraps before the blue 1 bar breaks, re-sealing the 13 tube.
